documentation.content:
The Cloud SQL instance's disk is over 80% used. Autoresize is on with no cap, so this is not an outage warning; it is the moment to look at the growth rate and the retention decision before the bill does it for you.

`gcloud sql instances describe loop-sessions --format='value(settings.dataDiskSizeGb,settings.storageAutoResize,settings.storageAutoResizeLimit)'` for the current size and the cap. The retention windows live in examples/deploy-gcp/cloudrun.yaml (RETENTION_BODY_DAYS, RETENTION_SESSION_DAYS) and are the owner's decision; the health_reports rollup and the derived-data cleanup are the levers that do not delete transcripts.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-cloudsql
